fields.statement: QA at d02d9ce (cycle 3) in real Rex. Built rhiza to a scratch dir, ran rhiza rex install into a scratch REX_CONFIG, then ran a throwaway rex server run on a scratch socket with --config at that init.lua (REX_SERVER pointed at itself, RHIZA_* unset). rex keymap on it lists 'ctrl+a a rhiza_launch rhiza.lua:44' beside the owner's 'ctrl+a r client.config.reload', and rex actions lists rhiza_launch. Made a session with -c at the scratch dir, then cd'd its shell into this checkout, and ran rex do rhiza_launch -s/-b on that shell block: a 'Rhiza apps' layer opened whose process cwd was the checkout (not $HOME nor the session's start dir), listing ready, roadmap, show, slice, why with summaries. send-key enter on ready closed it and opened a 'ready' block with this repo's change_sets JSON and the 'ready · j/k scroll · q quit' footer; the cycle-2 'no Rhiza repository' failure is fixed. Gap: the ctrl+a a keypress itself was not pressed in a real Rex.app client; when the action is called with no block in its context (rex.invoke from a script) the layer starts in the session's start dir.

QA at d02d9ce (cycle 3) with a built rhiza, REX_CONFIG at a scratch init.lua (owner lines incl. trailing spaces) and a fake rex first on PATH. rex install wrote rhiza.lua (settings launch_key ctrl+a a, BIN, block_cwd helper, rhiza_launch action passing cwd, bind) and appended one require("rhiza") -- added by rhiza rex install line; the fake rex logged config reload. A second install reported both unchanged and cmp found both files byte-identical. uninstall removed both and cmp shows init.lua equal to the owner's original. A real scratch Rex server loading the installed config bound ctrl+a a to rhiza_launch.

QA at d02d9ce (cycle 3) with a built rhiza on this repo's real model (RHIZA_ROOT/RUN/CHANGE/FOR unset). cmp shows rhiza <op> --json and rhiza tui app <op> --once byte-identical, both exit 0, for ready (14007 bytes), roadmap (19626) and, with --change 01M62JMSW4FH8RAWSQXHC7ZPND, slice (36321), show tui-launch-key (1332) and why quick-launch-layer (37320). In a real scratch Rex server the ready app opened from the launcher and showed the same change_sets JSON.
